seeds.comment-defaults: Plot Device project. Every key is optional; these are the defaults.
seeds.comment-language: the book's language: the words the app writes into it
seeds.comment-calendar: gregorian (dates like 1952-10-03) or day-count (day 14 of the story)
seeds.comment-file-names: when a title changes, rename its file: ask, always, or never
seeds.comment-order-prefix: true: start new chapter file names with their order number
seeds.comment-folders: where new files go, relative to this folder
seeds.comment-template: templates for new characters, locations, notes
